overview: MINTO proposes a simple yet effective bootstrapping rule that computes regression targets as the minimum between target and online network estimates, mitigating overestimation bias while leveraging fresh online updates for faster and stable reinforcement learning across value-based and actor-critic algorithms in both online and offline settings.

modules.name: MINTO Core Operator
modules.description: Implementation of the core MINTO bootstrapped target computation: y = r + γ * max_a' min(Q_target(s',a'), Q_online(s',a')). Includes stop-gradient handling for the online network component within the target, and logic for selecting between online and target estimates via the minimum operator.

modules.name: Target Network Management
modules.description: Manages the lifecycle of target networks including periodic hard updates (copying online parameters every T steps) and Polyak (soft) averaging updates. Supports both discrete (DQN-family) and continuous (SAC-family) update schedules as used across different algorithm integrations in the paper.

modules.name: Network Architectures
modules.description: Implements the neural network architectures used in the paper: vanilla CNN for Atari (with feature layers), IMPALA architecture with optional LayerNorm for Atari, and fully-connected MLP architectures for continuous control (Car-on-Hill, MuJoCo). Includes proper initialization and normalization layer support.

modules.name: MINTO-DQN Integration
modules.description: Integrates MINTO into the DQN algorithm, modifying only the target computation step. Implements the epsilon-greedy exploration, replay buffer sampling, MSE loss computation with stop-gradient targets, and the full DQN training loop with MINTO's minimum operator applied to next-state Q-values.

modules.name: MINTO-IQN Integration
modules.description: Integrates MINTO into the Implicit Quantile Network (distributional RL) algorithm. Modifies target quantile computation to use min between target and online quantile estimates, handles the action selection via argmax over minimum-averaged quantiles, and implements the quantile regression loss with MINTO targets.

modules.name: MINTO-CQL Integration
modules.description: Integrates MINTO into Conservative Q-Learning for offline RL. Combines the standard CQL conservative regularizer (penalizing OOD actions) with MINTO's minimum-based target computation. Implements the total loss as TD loss plus CQL regularizer, with MINTO-modified bootstrapped targets from the offline dataset.

modules.name: MINTO-SAC Integration
modules.description: Integrates MINTO into Soft Actor-Critic for continuous control. Supports both single-critic and double-critic (Clipped Double Q-Learning) variants. For single critic, applies min between target and online critic for next-state value estimation. For double critic, handles the design choice of aggregating or separating online estimates across critics. Includes entropy-regularized target computation.

modules.name: Operator Ablation Module
modules.description: Implements alternative combination operators for ablation study: Online Only, Target Only, Max (maximum of two estimates), Mean (average of two estimates), Random (equal probability selection), and Min (MINTO). Enables systematic comparison of operator choices on the same algorithms and environments.

modules.name: Baseline Algorithm Implementations
modules.description: Implements comparison baselines: Double DQN (decoupled action selection and evaluation), Functional Regularization DQN (online bootstrapping with target-network regularization), Self-correcting DQN (combined target-online action selection), and Maxmin DQN/Q (minimum across ensemble of estimators). Each baseline modifies only the target computation while sharing the same training infrastructure.

modules.name: Replay Buffer and Data Loading
modules.description: Implements experience replay buffers for both online and offline settings. For online RL, supports standard uniform sampling with configurable capacity. For offline RL, loads pre-collected datasets (RL Unplugged format) and provides batch sampling. Includes terminal state handling and discount factor application in transition storage.

modules.name: Atari Environment Wrappers
modules.description: Preprocessing pipeline for Atari environments: frame stacking, grayscale conversion, resizing, reward clipping, episode termination handling, and action repeat. Follows the standard Dopamine evaluation protocol and Machado et al. guidelines as specified in the paper's experimental setup.

modules.name: Continuous Control Environment Setup
modules.description: Environment configuration for MuJoCo locomotion tasks, HumanoidBench manipulation/locomotion tasks, and DeepMind Control Suite Hard tasks. Handles action repeat settings, episode length limits, observation normalization, and reward shaping specific to each benchmark suite.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Implements all evaluation metrics used in the paper: Area Under the Curve (AUC) capturing both sample efficiency and asymptotic performance, Interquartile Mean (IQM) return for robust aggregate scoring across tasks, confidence interval computation across multiple seeds, and online selection ratio tracking (frequency of choosing online vs target estimates during training).

modules.name: Value Estimation Bias Analysis
modules.description: Implements the Car-on-Hill analysis framework: computes ground-truth Q* via breadth-first search on a discretized state grid, tracks value estimation error (MSE between learned and true Q-values), averaged empirical bias (mean signed difference), and training loss curves. Enables comparison of overestimation/underestimation tendencies across MINTO and baselines.

modules.name: Unified Training Loop Framework
modules.description: Orchestrates the complete training workflow for all algorithm-environment combinations: epoch management, gradient update scheduling, periodic evaluation, target network synchronization, epsilon annealing, and early stopping. Supports both frame-based (Atari) and step-based (continuous control) training regimes with proper seeding for reproducibility.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration Management
modules.description: Manages hyperparameter configurations for all experiments: algorithm-specific settings (learning rates, target update frequencies, regularization parameters, ensemble sizes), architecture choices (CNN vs IMPALA, LayerNorm options), and benchmark-specific configurations. Supports experiment inheritance and variant specification for systematic comparison.

modules.name: Result Aggregation and Reporting
modules.description: Aggregates results across seeds, games/tasks, and algorithm variants. Generates performance curves with confidence intervals, per-task breakdown plots, aggregate AUC bar charts, normalized return comparisons, and ablation comparison figures. Produces both individual game/task plots and IQM-aggregated summaries as presented in the paper's appendix.
